displayName: Job Order (dispatched job on one machine)
description: Level-3 MOM JobOrder (ISA-95 Part 4 / B2MML JobOrder): the job of one machine within a Workorder (WorkRequest), with the material lot it requires or produces. No source yet — fed in the sim-v5 wave (operations carry no lot link in sim-v5 today).

attributes.name: job_order_no
attributes.description: Identity of the JobOrder (join key). Recommendation: <workorder_no>.<operation_no>.

attributes.name: workorder_ref
attributes.description: The Workorder (WorkRequest) this job belongs to.

attributes.name: machine_ref
attributes.description: The machine (Equipment) the job runs on.

attributes.name: material_lot_ref
attributes.description: The material lot the job requires or produces.

attributes.name: material_use
attributes.description: Whether the lot is consumed or produced by the job.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Dispatch state of the job as the source names it.

relationships.description: The Workorder this job is part of (ISA-95: WorkRequest MADE_UP_OF JobOrder).
The machine the job runs on (B2MML EquipmentRequirement).
The lot the job consumes or produces (B2MML MaterialRequirement, material_use).

isa95.note: ISA-95 Part 4 JobOrder = one dispatched job of a WorkRequest. The MaterialLot link now runs both ways through JobOrder REQUIRES_MATERIAL (owner 25.09.).
isa95.mappingNote: The parent WorkRequest is carried by B2MML through the nesting of JobOrder in WorkRequest, not as a field.
